mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (student_id, username, password_hash, full_name, role, is_active) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{fullName}, #{role}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, full_name = #{fullName}, role = #{role}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
